verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is an API-driven payments platform, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack has only general product and docs-landing claims. Nothing documents an interactive API reference or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404. The llms.txt file is an adjacent AI-readability feature, not an interactive reference, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
